solution_families.label: Most direct
solution_families.description: The smallest, most targeted change that addresses the specific problem instance without restructuring surrounding code or adding new abstractions. Preferred when the problem is well-bounded, the root cause is clear, and the change surface is narrow.

solution_families.label: Most robust
solution_families.description: A change that addresses the specific problem and adds defense-in-depth or broader correctness guarantees. May add validation, error handling, or test coverage beyond the minimum. Preferred when the problem has a plausible recurrence vector or when the direct fix is fragile.

solution_families.label: Most comprehensive
solution_families.description: A change that addresses the class of problem rather than just the observed instance. May involve a modest refactor, a new abstraction, or a policy-level fix. Preferred when research shows a repeated pattern, multiple closely related causes, or when the direct fix would be a band-aid.

prompt_guardrails.note: These adjectives are banned from stage prompts unless they appear only through injected taxonomy text. They steer toward expedient solutions rather than correct ones. Use the solution-family labels above to express tradeoffs.
